title: LLM weight intake -> pinflow autonomy: deterministic conversion, smoke, and profile publish
creator: Diego Martinez
description: Implement an end-to-end pipeline that takes community weights through deterministic conversion, fast compatibility validation, pin recommendation, and publishing of a runtime performance profile. The goal is a repeatable, auditable flow that supports multiple weight formats (PyTorch, safetensors, sharded checkpoints), produces a canonical runtime artifact, runs smoke and performance regressions, and emits a versioned profile to the catalog so downstream routing and cost tooling can use it.
acceptance_criteria: Weights accepted from S3 / Hugging Face with signed provenance manifest
Automatic conversion to canonical format (safetensors + metadata) with checksum & deterministic outputs
Deterministic unit and smoke tests pass in staging for CPU/GPU targets
Automated micro-benchmarks produce profile (latency P50/P95, memory, tokens/sec) and publish to profile-catalog with version tag
Pinflow heuristic outputs a recommended stable pin and stores mapping in pin-service; manual override path supported
Canary job deploys one variant to sandbox runtime and validates KV cache warmup and streaming correctness
Telemetry tags (model_family, version, quantization, conversion_tool) included in all emitted metrics and traces
Runbook created and linked for rollback and incident investigation
updates: 2025-02-17: Kickoff meeting — aligned eng, product, and reliability on required canary smoke suite. Action: spec conversion invariants (deterministic dtype ordering, RNG seeds, metadata canonicalization). Owner: Priya.

2025-02-21: Spike completed — tested conversion using safetensors CLI vs custom converter. Custom converter required for sharded Hugging Face checkpts; created RFC: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Deterministic+Conversion+RFC

2025-02-25: Implemented conversion step (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-ingest/pull/412). Conversion now emits sha256 checksums and normalized model.json with architecture fingerprints. Unit tests added.

2025-02-28: Added fast-compat validator that loads weights on target runtime (x86-gpu, a100) and runs smoke generation for 5 sample prompts. Validator failed on 2 community weights due to tokenization mismatch; created follow-ups for tokenizer mapping and manifest enrichment.

2025-03-02: Profile exporter implemented — collects P50/P95 single-request latency and steady-state throughput under 8 concurrent streams. Profiles published to profile-catalog (internal API: /api/catalog/profiles). First profile published for 'mistral-open-3b' candidate.

2025-03-04: Security review triage: safetensors ingestion requires KMS-wrapped manifest and scanning. Security requested additional signing for third-party manifests — planning 1-week follow-up. Security reviewer: Lena Fischer.
